stories.title: Flintshire assistant headteacher wins national apprenticeship award
stories.summary: A Flintshire assistant headteacher has won a national apprenticeship award after completing a leadership qualification while continuing to work across two school sites. Samantha Stenhoff, Assistant Headteacher at Ysgol Pen Coch, was named Higher Apprentice of the Year at the Cambrian Training Apprenticeship, Employment and Skills Awards on 2 June. stories.title: North Wales Police warns of rise in deepfake and voice-cloning scams
stories.summary: North Wales Police has issued a warning over a rise in scams using artificial intelligence to impersonate employers, bank staff and family members. The force’s cyber crime team says criminals are using voice-cloning and deepfake video technology to make fraudulent requests appear genuine. stories.title: Hawkesbury Little Theatre in Buckley warns of closure without urgent roof repairs
stories.summary: A theatre company in Buckley has launched an urgent crowdfunding appeal, warning that its venue could shut permanently without £30,000 to replace a failing roof. Buckley Theatre Club, which performs at Hawkesbury Little Theatre on Hawkesbury Drive, says a section of the roof has deteriorated to the point where water ingress is a real risk.
